label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: [name] banner Decline worked, but a country-picker block (Hey, are you in the right place?) appeared twice in the tree below the footer, duplicated and out of context.

element.name: Hey, are you in the right place?

findings.problem: Many unnamed links and image-only links in product cards (colour swatches, empty links) and main nav items named only by a nested navigation element, so I could not tell what they do.
Size links xs/s/m/l/xl do not say which is selected or which are sold out; the buttons next to Add to bag have no names.
After Add to bag nothing was announced; cart count still said 0 and the cart drawer only showed up on a later read, with focus left on the button.
Checkout opens with an upsell (Protect Your Order) placed inside Express checkout region before contact fields, adding noise before the form.
